test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 29 Jul, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which program was launched to make India a global leader in digital technology?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Digital India**__.

**__Key Points__**

• **Digital India** was launched on **1 July 2015** by **Prime Minister Narendra Modi**. The program is designed to transform India into a **digitally empowered society** and a **knowledge economy**. It aims to provide high-speed internet, digital identity, and easy access to government services to every citizen. *Hence, this statement is correct.*

• **Make in India** was launched on **25 September 2014** with the goal of turning India into a global **manufacturing hub**. It focuses on attracting foreign direct investment (**FDI**) and improving the ease of doing business in **25 sectors** of the economy. *Hence, this statement is incorrect.*

• **Skill India** (National Skill Development Mission) was launched on **15 July 2015** to provide **vocational training** and certification to millions of Indian youth. It aims to bridge the gap between industry requirements and the skill sets of the workforce to increase employability. *Hence, this statement is incorrect.*

• **Startup India** was launched on **16 January 2016**
